title: Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic stew originating from Algeria, made with a blend of spices, vegetables, and warm flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the ginger, cumin, and turmeric powders and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, or until the vegetables start to soften.
Add the chickpeas, canned tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
